definitions.explanation: A person's home or residence. Often used with the honorific prefix お to refer politely to someone else's home (お宅). Also used as a suffix to indicate someone's residence.

examples.japanese: ⟦お{宅|たく}→お宅：01569_otaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦どちら→どちら：00927_dochira⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
⟦{田中|たなか}→田中：09528_tanaka⟧{宅|たく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{届|とど}ける→届ける：01248_todokeru⟧。
examples.english: To deliver a package to the Tanaka residence.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自宅|じたく}→自宅：00129_jitaku⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{三十分|さんじゅっぷん}→三十分：09672_sanjuppun⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: It takes thirty minutes by train from home to the office.

notes:
{宅|たく} is a somewhat formal word for home or residence. In everyday conversation, ⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧ or うち is more common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦お{宅|たく}→お宅：01569_otaku⟧ (your home — polite; also "otaku" when written as a pronoun)
- ⟦{自宅|じたく}→自宅：00129_jitaku⟧ (one's own home)
- ⟦{在宅|ざいたく}→在宅：07696_zaitaku⟧ (being at home)
- ⟦{宅配|たくはい}→宅配：09571_takuhai⟧ (home delivery)
- ⟦{帰宅|きたく}→帰宅：02546_kitaku⟧ (returning home)

USAGE:
As a standalone word, {宅|たく} is primarily used as a suffix after family names (⟦{田中|たなか}→田中：09528_tanaka⟧{宅|たく}) or in compound words. ⟦お{宅|たく}→お宅：01569_otaku⟧ is the polite form used to refer to another person's home, and is also used as a second-person pronoun in polite speech.
